checks.message: Provisional boundary is explicitly disclosed and not presented as official.

Adjacent land-use polygons are derived from one site polygon and cover it without intended gaps.
Offline page has no CDN, remote map, script, iframe, form or API call.
ReportLab generated multi-page PDFs from the same five derived figures.
All required standards, depth items, data layers and known metrics are referenced in the readable proposal.
